purpose: 补全独立桌灯工作台的真实保存流程：其他页面已保存时，旧页面不能直接覆盖，先保留并备份本页方案，再检查最新完整存档，明确打开并可撤销找回原方案；同时修复准备阶段过早编辑和线程故障后的迟到保存。

scope.otherStorageKeys: Source and isolated Node tests address only the support key. This browser run did not secretly read or compare the other ten workspace records.

historicalEvidence.meaning: The prior three-table geometry, drag, native-file and actual disk-download evidence remains historical. This reliability run did not repeat that full asset protocol or make a new disk download.

frozenPolicy.meaning: Existing frozen source-triangle coverage and conservative collision checks are unchanged. Reusing these assets is not another unseen-asset evaluation.

storage.initialBaseline: Exact raw string or known null established only after a successful initial read.
storage.save: Validate v1 envelope and UTF-8 64 KiB limit; caller first validates source fingerprints and full geometry. Re-read and compare exact baseline, write own key, then require exact readback before advancing baseline.
storage.adoption: Worker checks full saved backup without mutating the scene. Explicit open rechecks current raw, restores through worker, then rechecks current raw before adopting the save baseline.
storage.changesDuringPreview: Own-key storage events invalidate checked text and disable open, while keeping the local displayed scheme.
storage.failure: Unknown baseline, read/write exceptions, malformed/oversize stored record and differing readback block success; no force-overwrite or blind automatic rollback.
storage.limitation: localStorage read/compare/write/read has no atomic compare-and-swap. A writer between comparison and write may be overwritten, and a later writer may replace a successfully verified record. The explicitly tested sequential stale-page guard does not establish simultaneous-write safety.
storage.lateRestoreWindow: If the record changes after worker restoration but before baseline adoption, the app may display the just-checked version with undo available, rejects baseline adoption and performs no save. This narrow UI race was not injected in the actual browser.

lifecycle.preparationGate: Asset, face, mode, edits, orbit and save wait for model preparation plus the first coherent render.
lifecycle.fatalGate: Late startup or operation completion cannot unlock controls or return an export to the saving handler after fatal worker failure.
lifecycle.pointerBegin: A rejected transaction begin releases capture.
lifecycle.cameraOrResize: Mode, viewpoint and resize handlers cancel an active transaction before changing the view; real held-input cancellation at these boundaries remains pending.

automatic.observation: Full suites were executed by the parent task after the final core fixes. Evidence assembly independently counted new test definitions and validated public artifacts, without rerunning or rewriting historical reports.
storageCoverage: Initial raw/null baseline, independent sessions and formatting-only conflicts
Stale save, external deletion or damaged/oversize record and UTF-8 limit
Exact adoption recheck and preservation of original formatting
Blocked provider, invalid read type, unknown baseline, read/write/quota exceptions and missing interface
Readback mismatch, silent failed write and competing deletion/write with no blind rollback
Only the support key is addressed; no force-overwrite API
Explicit counterexample showing comparison plus write is not an atomic lock
appLifecycleVmCases: Deferred renderer preparation prevents asset/mode/save operations until the first coherent render
Failure during preparation is not undone by a late startup snapshot
Failure while a save awaits rendering prevents storage write and control reactivation
Rejected transaction begin releases pointer capture without sending an update
automatic.limits: Storage faults use controlled Node adapters. Four lifecycle tests execute the actual app.js coordinator in a VM with stub DOM, Worker and scene renderer. These are useful code-level regressions, not real browser/device failure injection or real pointer-hold evidence.

actualBrowser.method: Same-origin two actual IAB tabs; visible controls and complete public JSON fields only. Sequential writes, not simultaneous race or OS-window testing.
actualBrowser.storageInspection: Visible controls and full public JSON fields only; no hidden browser-storage reads or mutations.

steps.action: A nudged lamp right 5 cm and explicitly saved.
steps.result: A first saved raw was collected through the public backup field.

steps.action: B nudged lamp left 5 cm and tried to save from its old baseline.
steps.result: Save conflict dialog opened. B retained its complete local draft.

steps.action: B chose backup of its own draft.
steps.result: Complete public text was exactly the pre-save B draft, and a download href was available. No new actual disk download was performed in this run.

steps.action: B reopened the conflict dialog and checked the latest record.
steps.result: Read-only full public saved text exactly equalled A first saved raw; B had not overwritten A.

steps.action: A nudged lamp back 5 cm and explicitly saved again.
steps.result: B received a storage event: its checked preview was cleared and open disabled. Its local displayed arrangement was retained.

steps.action: B checked again and explicitly opened the second A record.
steps.result: Checked and adopted complete public JSON exactly equalled A second saved raw.
Undo restored the whole original unsaved B draft; Redo restored the whole adopted A second record.

steps.action: B explicitly saved after adopting and redoing.
steps.result: Save succeeded with the adopted current baseline.

steps.action: A checked and explicitly restored the original 797-byte scheme, then saved; B actually reloaded.
steps.result: The final restored and actual reloaded whole public text exactly equalled the original baseline.

cleanup.originalDraftComparison: Parent task compared the complete public draft before and after. Only the true outcome is published; the original private draft text is excluded.

actualBrowser.limits: Two actual tabs executed controlled sequential UI actions. This is not simultaneous-write, separate OS-window, cross-browser, mobile touch, offline, latency or fault-injection evidence. The narrow record change during asynchronous restoration was not forced.

publicArtifactVerification.distinction: Raw equality, UTF-8 byte length, JSON envelope and controlled coordinate changes are reproducible from the published artifact. Disabled-control state, available download href, actual reload, console and preservation of the excluded private draft are recorded UI observations, not inferred from raw equality alone.

artifacts.meaning: Actual browser screenshot of the save-conflict interface. JPEG signature and dimensions were checked from returned capture bytes. Not an AI-generated image or proof of simultaneous-write safety.
Complete public baseline/draft/checked/adopted/undo/redo/reloaded texts plus recorded UI outcomes. The original existing-page private draft is excluded.

sourceCodeSnapshot.hashing: SHA-256 over exact working-tree file bytes at report assembly time, without line-ending normalization. This identifies the source snapshot and does not claim the Git-normalized blob has identical bytes.

stillPending: Real Escape while pointer held, lost capture, blur/hidden, camera/resize interruption during an active gesture
Real worker failure and blocked storage/quota/write/readback faults in the browser; the current evidence is Node or VM fixtures
Truly simultaneous save races and an atomic persistence design; the current localStorage guard is not an atomic lock
Record changes within the asynchronous restoration/adoption window in the actual browser
Repair or recovery flow for malformed/oversize existing records; ordinary save deliberately cannot overwrite them
Touch devices, other browsers, separate OS windows, offline sessions, long-running latency and memory budgets
Additional genuinely unseen source assets, semantic categories and real hole/concave/separated/upper-obstacle tabletops
Cabinet or shelf levels and clearance rules; arbitrary upload, slopes, curved support and multiple feet
Physical bearing, center of mass, contact force and engineering safety
Migration into the old living room and ten-record whole-workspace backup after separate acceptance
Full protocol A–E completion and the remaining bounded research capability
